source_units: Studio Mate lets you quickly locate your DAW (e.g., Pro Tools) from timecode markers added on top of a PDF. Use scores, scripts, and review PDFs “as is” and cut the back-and-forth between recording, editing, and review. Version 3.5 improves PDF import, sharing, and export, with a page progress bar, resizable thumbnails, and a Pro Tools MIDI Input Devices setup guide in Help / FAQ.
Add synchronized timecode markers anywhere on a PDF.
Tap a marker to jump your DAW to the exact position.
Toggle between seconds and frames for precision.
Adjust pre-roll for talent or orchestra sessions.
Use the built-in stopwatch to mark elapsed time without a DAW link.
Keep OK/NG and retake notes with colors and handwriting.
Write timecode directly on script lines in the PDF.
Rough timing with the stopwatch outside the studio.
Mark timecode on a notes PDF and return during review.
Keep direction notes in the PDF for the next stage.
